mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CIRCLES_ROOM WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}

SELECT visit_time, user_name, circles_title, etc FROM ( SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(visit_time, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) AS visit_time, user_name, circles_title, etc FROM CIRCLES_ROOM WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND visit_date = #{visit_date} AND circles_div = #{circles_div} CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(visit_time, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY visit_time, user_name, circles_title, etc

SELECT NVL(MAX(circles_idx), 0)+1 FROM CIRCLES_ROOM WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
INSERT INTO CIRCLES_ROOM ( homepage_id, circles_idx, circles_div, user_id, user_ci, user_name, user_addr, user_phone, user_tel, visit_date, visit_time, visit_num, manage_code, etc, status, ip, add_id, add_date, circles_title, rec_key, origin_file_name, server_file_name, file_extension, file_size ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, #{circles_idx}, #{circles_div}, #{user_id}, #{user_ci}, #{user_name}, #{user_addr}, #{user_phone}, #{user_tel}, #{visit_date}, #{visit_time}, #{visit_num}, #{manage_code}, #{etc}, 0, #{ip}, #{add_id}, SYSDATE, #{circles_title}, #{rec_key}, #{origin_file_name}, #{server_file_name}, #{file_extension}, #{file_size} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CIRCLES_ROOM SET status = #{status}, modify_id = #{modify_id}, modify_date = SYSDATE WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND circles_idx = #{circles_idx}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 ) numbers INNER JOIN circles_room ON CHAR_LENGTH (visit_time) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(visit_time, ',', '')) >= numbers.n-1 WHERE visit_date = #{visit_date} AND visit_time in (#{visit_time}) ORDER BY visit_time ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CIRCLES_ROOM WHERE TO_DATE(ADD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(ADD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(SYSDATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND user_id = #{user_id}
